_readme: Bounded probe of the registers east of Germany (decisions.md D12; PRO-107: decided in this run, never degraded in advance). One or two lookups per country on 2026-10-06, raw answers under probe/. Budget: about fifteen requests in all.

verdicts.register: ARES (ares.gov.cz), the business register's public REST API
verdicts.access: free, no key, JSON; name search (POST .../ekonomicke-subjekty/vyhledat) and the public-register extract by company number (GET .../ekonomicke-subjekty-vr/<ico>)
verdicts.status: usable: dates of formation and dissolution per entity
verdicts.backtrace: usable: an s.r.o. lists its members; an a.s. lists its sole shareholder, and the capital-increase resolutions filed with the register NAME every subscriber with share count and issue price
verdicts.forward: not tested (no search by shareholder in the API)
verdicts.finding: Socialbakers a.s. (ICO 29098271, now Emplifi Czech Republic a.s.): the resolutions of 2012-10-26 and 2014-01-28 name 'Earlybird Verwaltungs GmbH, Munich, Maximilianstrasse 14, HRB 128 047' as subscriber of 1,209 preferred shares at CZK 100 + USD 1,201.69 each and of 1,870 class C preferred shares at CZK 100 + USD 3,471.24 each. Filing-grade evidence that a home fund's general partner, not the Digital East Fund, held the position (decisions.md D2), and a dated price per round.
verdicts.verdict: usable, cheap and good; proposed for write-back to COLLECTION.md s5

verdicts.register: RPO, the Register of Legal Entities (api.statistics.sk/rpo/v1)
verdicts.access: free, no key, JSON; search by name, entity detail with history
verdicts.status: usable: establishment and termination dates, renames (Photoneo s. r. o. is now Brightpick s. r. o.)
verdicts.backtrace: usable for an s.r.o.: every member with validity dates, foreign funds included, and every change of registered capital with its date (the rounds); a j.s.a. (simple joint-stock company) lists no shareholders
verdicts.finding: Photoneo s. r. o. (RPO 424797): 'Digital East Fund 2013 SCA SICAR' is a member from 2019-01-17 (capital raised to EUR 186,669 that day), beside Credo and RSJ. The register names the Digital East SICAR, not an Earlybird fund: the investing entity of decisions.md D2 on the public record.
verdicts.verdict: usable, cheap and good; proposed for write-back to COLLECTION.md s5

verdicts.access: free JSON, but by KRS number only: no name search
verdicts.verdict: usable only once the number is known from the company's own imprint; not tested further (one Polish row, Alokai, and it is a Digital East position)

verdicts.access: the ONRC portal did not answer (and its company data needs an account); ANAF's public API answers by fiscal code (CUI)
verdicts.status: usable through ANAF once the CUI is known (UiPath SRL, CUI 34737997: registered, with address)
verdicts.backtrace: not available without an ONRC account
verdicts.verdict: status only, and only with the fiscal code; no membership evidence

verdicts.access: a JavaScript application; the one API path tried returned an empty answer
verdicts.verdict: not established within the budget; the obstacle is the undocumented API behind the portal

verdicts.access: the gazette's notice search redirects to a member login (girisyap.php); MERSIS needs an e-Devlet (Turkish e-government) login
verdicts.verdict: not usable: both doors need a Turkish registered login. Turkish status and membership stay with the firm's own record and the press.

what_it_changes: Nothing in the published base (D2 partitions the Digital East rows on the firm's own words). The Czech and Slovak registers independently confirm D2's line on its two test rows: Socialbakers was financed by the home funds' general partner, Photoneo by the Digital East SICAR.
